cover_letter:
Dear Thistlebox Data Team,

I am applying for the Data Scientist role.

At Firth Energy Retail I work as a junior data analyst, where I segment customers and analyse tariffs in R and SQL. I automated our monthly regulator reports with R Markdown, which saved the team about two days each month.

My MSc in Statistics, with a dissertation on Bayesian hierarchical models, gave me a strong foundation in experimental design and modelling uncertainty. I would love to apply this to a fast-moving consumer business where experiments drive decisions every week.

I have been learning Python to complement R, and I am comfortable with pandas and scikit-learn.

Thank you for considering my application.

Kind regards,
Tobias Mwangi-Hartley
